verdicts.reason: A: the headline sits right against the cropped photo, and the 'EXHIBITION' label has moved from above the title to the end of the address line, which breaks the reading order. The logo has shrunk to an illegible speck, and there is dead space on the right. Still, its date block is a usable size. B has the same reading-order and logo problems, but its date block is shrunk until the hours line can't be read. The headline's 'C' runs into the photo's edge, and the photo is pushed hard against the left edge of the canvas while about a quarter of the canvas on the right sits empty.
